title: Prominence "Rose on 30A" 106 East Milestone Drive Unit C
h1: Prominence "Rose on 30A" 106 East Milestone Drive Unit C
description_expanded: HOME HIGHLIGHTS:*Remodeled in 2025- Close proximity to the beach- Walking distance to The Big Chill - Restaurants & Pubs, Boutique Shops & Nightly Entertainment- 2 Large Community Pools and Barbecue Areas - Fitness Facility- 2 Adult bikes- Parking for 2 vehicle- Garage- Complete Clean Linen Participant - All linens, including comforter covers, are laundered upon every checkoutDETAILS: Happiness blooms at Rose on 30A, a beautiful 2-bedroom, 2-bathroom Prominence townhome that sleeps 6 guests. Neighboring Deer Lake State Park offers exciting days of hiking, birdwatching, and exploring the area’s rare coastal dune lakes. Take advantage of the 2 community pools and barbecue areas for warm-weather fun, or walk over to The Big Chill for shopping, dining, and entertainment! Guests will love this home’s peaceful porch—the ultimate spot to start each morning with a fragrant cup of coffee.The first level of this 2-story property welcomes guests with crisp white wainscoting and a classic staircase leading to the main floor.Ascend to find a spacious living and dining space accented with shades of blush, blue, and beige for cheerful warmth, while dark hardwood floors and a 10-foot tray ceiling invoke a sense of elevated elegance. Artful chairs and a beach rattan pendant light add a playful atmosphere to group meals at the 6-seat dining table. In the open living space, a plush L-shaped couch and cozy armchair beckon guests for a comfortable night watching TV or swapping stories over glasses of chilled white wine. The modern kitchen is seamlessly connected and features polished countertops, high-end appliances, and a breakfast bar for 4. Double glass doors off the living and dining area lead onto a covered, screened-in porch with cushioned patio seating and a drinks’ table, perfect for unwinding with a book in the gentle breeze. Flanking the great room are the inviting sleeping accommodations, including a tranquil primary bedroom with a king bed and private bathroom, and a light-filled bunk room with a queen-over-queen bunk bed and balcony access. An in-unit washer and dryer add convenience.Discover a delightful beach getaway at Rose on 30A in Prominence. Guests have everything they need for a convenient vacation, with parking for 2 vehicle and 2 complimentary adult bikes. Beach access is a short drive or ride away at Walton Dunes or Deer Creek Beach Access on Deer Lake State Park. Book today!SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTS: (SLEEPS 6):SECOND FLOOR:- Primary Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower Only- Guest Bedroom: Queen-over-Queen Bunk Bed, Shared Bathroom with Shower/Tub Combo** The community north pool is heated, seasonally, during fall and early spring.*The official address of this home is in Panama City, but many of the amenities are within Watersound.
